work.abstract_text: We prove Paul D. Hanna's conjecture in the COMMENTS of OEIS A381355, revision 13 (March 12, 2025): its nth term is divisible by the nth prime for every n>1. The source series of A381353 exists uniquely over the rationals and has integer coefficients. More generally, positive exponents m_n with gcd(m_n,n!)=1 define an integral source series with any prescribed integer linear coefficient, and m_n divides the nth logarithmic coefficient. The same argument proves companion integrality and the prime divisibility conjecture in A393867. A parity argument proves its oddness conjecture and the even-run conjecture in A393868. We also correct the coefficient index in A393866, FORMULA (2), and give a general nonzero-diagonal congruence.

work.title: Prime-index divisibility in Hanna's OEIS A381355: Revision 13, COMMENTS, and shifted-power siblings
